summary: Akinator entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Akinator

emulation.notes: Use official web or mobile service.

primary.why: Akinator is a web and mobile guessing game whose knowledge base changes over time, so the current official web service is the main archive route. Mobile apps are useful access routes but should be logged by app version and account state.
primary.how_to_play: Use the official web version. Record date, language, category/mode, session result, login/account state, ads/subscription state, and whether mobile app behavior was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Mobile app UI, monetization, and category/version differences
secondary.what_to_play: Compare only if mobile-specific behavior matters.
secondary.why: The core game is service-backed, but app version and monetization can change the experience.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record date, category, language, and account/app state because the guessing database evolves.
